results.title: Glossary > Valves
results.content:
A valve is what the [`plumbing::open_valve`] function returns when it opens a pipe. It
can also mean the handle of a whole [`ValveGroup`].

[`plumbing::open_valve`]: https://docs.example.com/plumbing/2/plumbing/fn.open_valve.html
[`ValveGroup`]: https://docs.example.com/plumbing/2/plumbing/struct.ValveGroup.html

results.title: Valves > Introduction (part 2) / Handles
results.content:
> **info**
> Opening a valve and reading its flow are separate steps. A handle can be kept
> after the flow stops, and read again later.

Every call to `open_valve` returns a `ValveHandle`. The handle closes the valve
when it is dropped, unless `leak` was called on it first.

```rust
let handle = plumbing::open_valve(Pipe::cold());
let litres = handle.flow().total();
handle.close();
```

A handle is cheap to move between threads, but only the plumber that opened the
valve can close it.
